title: Login with valid credentials redirects to dashboard
description: Verifies a user can log in with correct email and password and reach the authenticated dashboard.

title: Signup shows email verification prompt
description: Verifies a new user signup attempt shows an email verification prompt after submitting the signup form.

title: Login with invalid email format shows validation/auth error
description: Verifies an invalid email format prevents successful login and an error is shown to the user.

title: Login with wrong password shows authentication error and stays on login
description: Verifies a user cannot log in with a valid-looking email but incorrect password and sees an authentication error.

title: Login with empty fields shows required-field error
description: Verifies the login form prevents submission when email and password are empty and shows a visible error message.

title: Signup with invalid email shows validation/auth error
description: Verifies the signup flow rejects an invalid email format and shows a visible error message.

title: Password field masks input on login form
description: Verifies the password field behaves like a password input (masked) on the login page.

title: Login button shows loading/disabled state during submission (if present)
description: Verifies the UI indicates in-progress submission after clicking Login, reducing duplicate submissions.

title: Dashboard shows core overview sections (balance, breakdown, recent transactions)
description: Verifies the authenticated dashboard renders total balance, income/expense breakdown, and recent transactions sections.

title: Dashboard displays income/expense breakdown values on load
description: Verifies the dashboard income and expense breakdown area is visible and presents both categories.

title: Dashboard recent transactions list is visible and structured
description: Verifies the recent transactions area is visible and shows a list/table-like structure for entries.

steps.description: Verify element "Recent transactions list" is visible

title: Autonomy KPI card is visible on the dashboard
description: Verifies the dashboard includes a KPI card related to autonomy calculation.

steps.description: Verify element "Autonomia KPI card" is visible

title: Open autonomy KPI details modal from the dashboard
description: Verifies clicking the autonomy KPI card opens a details modal.

steps.description: Verify element "Autonomia detail modal" is visible

title: Close autonomy details modal
description: Verifies the autonomy KPI details modal can be dismissed and returns to the dashboard view.

title: Login with invalid credentials shows an error and stays on login page
description: Verifies invalid login prevents access and shows a visible error message.

title: Login validation: missing password prevents successful login
description: Verifies the login form shows a visible validation message when password is missing.

title: Create an Expense transaction and verify it appears in the transactions list
description: Verifies a user can add a new Expense transaction via the "Nova Transação" dialog and then see it in the list.

steps.description: Click on "Transações" in the app navigation/menu
Click on "Nova Transação" to open the dialog
Type "Groceries - E2E" into the description field
Select "Expense" from the transaction type control
Select "Alimentação" (or any available category) from the category dropdown
Click on the "Salvar" / "Adicionar" / "Submit" button in the dialog

title: Create an Income transaction and verify it appears in the transactions list
description: Verifies a user can add a new Income transaction and then see it in the list.

steps.description: Click on "Transações" in the app navigation/menu
Click on "Nova Transação" to open the dialog
Type "Salary - E2E" into the description field
Select "Income" from the transaction type control
Select any available category from the category dropdown
Click on the "Salvar" / "Adicionar" / "Submit" button in the dialog

title: Form validation: submit with required field missing, then correct and successfully create transaction
description: Verifies required-field validation appears and that the user can correct the form and submit successfully.

steps.description: Click on "Transações" in the app navigation/menu
Click on "Nova Transação" to open the dialog
Type "Validation - E2E" into the description field
Select "Expense" from the transaction type control
Click on the "Salvar" / "Adicionar" / "Submit" button in the dialog
Select any available category from the category dropdown
Click on the "Salvar" / "Adicionar" / "Submit" button in the dialog

title: Close the "Nova Transação" dialog without submitting and verify no transaction is added
description: Verifies a user can dismiss the add-transaction dialog and that no new transaction is created as a side effect.

steps.description: Click on "Transações" in the app navigation/menu
Click on "Nova Transação" to open the dialog
Type "Dismiss - E2E" into the description field
Click on the "Cancelar" / close (X) control to close the dialog
Verify text "Nova Transação" is not visible
Verify text "Dismiss - E2E" is not visible

title: Delete an existing transaction and confirm it is removed from the list
description: Verifies a user can delete a transaction from the list and confirm it disappears after confirmation.

steps.description: Click on "Transações" in the app navigation/menu
Click on "Nova Transação" to open the dialog
Type "DeleteMe - E2E" into the description field
Select "Expense" from the transaction type control
Select any available category from the category dropdown
Click on the "Salvar" / "Adicionar" / "Submit" button in the dialog
Click on "Delete" / trash icon for the transaction row containing "DeleteMe - E2E"
Verify text "Confirmar" or "Tem certeza" or "Confirm" is visible
Click on the "Confirmar" / "Delete" button in the confirmation dialog
Verify text "DeleteMe - E2E" is not visible

title: Cancel deletion from confirmation dialog and verify transaction remains visible
description: Verifies a user can initiate deletion but cancel in the confirmation dialog, leaving the transaction intact.

steps.description: Click on "Transações" in the app navigation/menu
Click on "Nova Transação" to open the dialog
Type "KeepMe - E2E" into the description field
Select "Expense" from the transaction type control
Select any available category from the category dropdown
Click on the "Salvar" / "Adicionar" / "Submit" button in the dialog
Click on "Delete" / trash icon for the transaction row containing "KeepMe - E2E"
Click on the "Cancelar" / "Cancel" button in the confirmation dialog
